title: dnd4e Lazy Sheet ChatData
description: DnD 4th Edition (dnd4e system) only — does not run on other systems. Performance patches for the dnd4e actor sheet (Foundry v14), tested against dnd4e 0.9.2: deferred getChatData / partial enrichHTML during sheet prep, plus an embedded sheet performance probe (lib/sheet-perf-probe.js). Requires lib-wrapper. Disable the standalone sheet-perf-probe module if it is still enabled in the world to avoid double libWrapper hooks on _renderHTML.
